title: Nationaal Scholierenonderzoek 1996 - NSO'96
authors: Warnaar, M.F., Berg, C. van den, NIBUD * Utrecht (primary investigator)
descriptions: Survey among pupils of secondary schools with a great number of detailed questions about their living conditions, opinions and attitudes. Living conditions at school and at home / income / jobs / holiday work / money spending / dealing with money / time spending / education / independence / political preference / religious conviction / physical and mental health / type of school / age at which respondent came to the Netherlands Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ politics/ religion/ consumption of durables. The data- and documentation files of this dataset can be downloaded via the option Data Files.
